name: Iut.ThetaDataExistence.mk
elaboratedType:
∀ {T : Genl.HeightTheory.{u_1}} {AG : Iut.AnabelianGeometry.{u}} {TG : Iut.TemperedGeometry.{u} AG}
  {P : Iut.Corollary312VariantData.{u, v} AG TG → Prop} {K : Genl.HeightTheory.CBS.{u_1} T} {d : ℕ}
  {I : Iut.Corollary22Inputs.{u_2, u_1} T K d},
  (∀ (x : Genl.HeightTheory.Pt.{u_1} T (Genl.HeightTheory.tripod.{u_1} T))
      (hx :
        Membership.mem.{u_1, u_1}
          (Inter.inter.{u_1} (Genl.HeightTheory.cbsSet.{u_1} T K)
            (Genl.HeightTheory.ptLE.{u_1} T (Genl.HeightTheory.tripod.{u_1} T) d))
          x),
      x ∉ Iut.Corollary22Inputs.excCore.{u_2, u_1} I →
        ∀ (ℓ : ℕ),
          Nat.Prime ℓ →
            LE.le.{0} 7 ℓ →
              (∀ (v : Iut.LocalHeightData.ι.{u_2} (Iut.Corollary22Inputs.localData.{u_2, u_1} I x hx)),
                  Membership.mem.{u_2, u_2}
                      (Iut.LocalHeightData.bad.{u_2} (Iut.Corollary22Inputs.localData.{u_2, u_1} I x hx)) v →
                    ¬Dvd.dvd.{0} ℓ
                        (Iut.LocalHeightData.hv.{u_2} (Iut.Corollary22Inputs.localData.{u_2, u_1} I x hx) v)) →
                (∀ (v : Iut.LocalHeightData.ι.{u_2} (Iut.Corollary22Inputs.localData.{u_2, u_1} I x hx)),
                    Membership.mem.{u_2, u_2}
                        (Iut.LocalHeightData.bad.{u_2} (Iut.Corollary22Inputs.localData.{u_2, u_1} I x hx)) v →
                      Eq.{1} (Iut.LocalHeightData.p.{u_2} (Iut.Corollary22Inputs.localData.{u_2, u_1} I x hx) v) ℓ →
                        LT.lt.{0} ↑(Iut.LocalHeightData.hv.{u_2} (Iut.Corollary22Inputs.localData.{u_2, u_1} I x hx) v)
                          √(Iut.Corollary22Inputs.h.{u_2, u_1} I x)) →
                  (∃ (v : Iut.LocalHeightData.ι.{u_2} (Iut.Corollary22Inputs.localData.{u_2, u_1} I x hx)),
                      Membership.mem.{u_2, u_2}
                          (Iut.LocalHeightData.bad.{u_2} (Iut.Corollary22Inputs.localData.{u_2, u_1} I x hx)) v ∧
                        Ne.{1} (Iut.LocalHeightData.p.{u_2} (Iut.Corollary22Inputs.localData.{u_2, u_1} I x hx) v) 2 ∧
                          Ne.{1} (Iut.LocalHeightData.p.{u_2} (Iut.Corollary22Inputs.localData.{u_2, u_1} I x hx) v)
                            ℓ) →
                    Iut.Corollary22Inputs.SL2Image.{u_2, u_1} I x ℓ →
                      ∃ (X : Iut.Corollary312VariantData.{u, v} AG TG) (inv : Iut.Theorem110Invariants.{u, v} X),
                        P X ∧
                          Iut.Theorem110Certificate.{u, v} inv ∧
                            Nonempty.{max (u + 1) (v + 1)} (Iut.Theorem110Invariants.LocalEstimate.{u, v} inv) ∧
                              Eq.{1} (Iut.Corollary312VariantData.ℓ.{u, v} X) ℓ ∧
                                LE.le.{0} (Iut.Corollary312VariantData.dmod.{u, v} X) d ∧
                                  Eq.{1} (Iut.QPilotData.logQ.{u} (Iut.Corollary312VariantData.qPilot.{u, v} X))
                                      (Iut.LocalHeightData.heightOther.{u_2}
                                        (Iut.Corollary22Inputs.localData.{u_2, u_1} I x hx) 2 ℓ) ∧
                                    Eq.{1} (Genl.HeightTheory.logDiff.{u_1} T (Genl.HeightTheory.tripod.{u_1} T) x)
                                        (Iut.Theorem110Invariants.logDtpd.{u, v} inv) ∧
                                      LE.le.{0} (Iut.Theorem110Invariants.logFtpd.{u, v} inv)
                                          (Genl.HeightTheory.logCond.{u_1} T (Genl.HeightTheory.tripod.{u_1} T) x) ∧
                                        LE.le.{0}
                                          (Genl.HeightTheory.logCond.{u_1} T (Genl.HeightTheory.tripod.{u_1} T) x)
                                          (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} (Iut.Theorem110Invariants.logFtpd.{u, v} inv)
                                            (Real.log (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} 2 ↑ℓ)))) →
    Iut.ThetaDataExistence.{u, v, u_1, u_2} P I

elaboratedTelescope.result: Iut.ThetaDataExistence.{u, v, u_1, u_2} P I
